columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: Constant 'No' — explicit source statement that the net price is tax-exclusive. No VAT-inclusion question is needed because the file states the fact directly; it justifies emitting tax_fraction from the stated rate rather than adjusting the price.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Constant '5%' for every row, an explicit per-row source rate (not a retail convention). Must be converted to the fraction 0.05 for the contract's tax_fraction number; the fixture value is taken as given.

columns.name: Valid from (DD/MM/YYYY)
